name: linux-desktop-configuration
description: Shared Linux desktop (GNOME/Ubuntu) configuration rules for Codex agents: safe GNOME Shell reloads, clean-install compatibility, and root-optional installers.

interface.shortDescription: Console-only desktop deployment, clean-install rules, and sudo-free installer patterns.
interface.longDescription: Keeps the shared Linux desktop configuration guidance available as a reusable Codex skill: apply desktop changes silently from the command line, activate edited extension code with the sanctioned in-place X11 run-dialog reload (xdotool Alt+F2 r) while still forbidding destructive session restarts, ask for manual logout to activate extension code on Wayland, preserve user sessions, maintain clean installation compatibility, and avoid sudo wherever possible.
defaultPrompt: Apply the Linux desktop configuration guidelines to this task.
